intro.headline: Less time fighting admin. More time selling trips.
intro.text: You didn't start a travel agency to wrestle with spreadsheets. Here's what your days look like once every quote, payment and supplier lives in one place.

requests.title: Never lose a lead again
requests.benefit: Every enquiry in one list, so no client ever slips through the cracks.
points: Every enquiry lands in the same place, with a status you read at a glance: new, waiting, handled
Open a client and their whole history is right there: enquiries, quotes, orders, invoices
Their details and tax information are ready to drop straight into a quote, no retyping
requests.change: You stop wondering "did I ever reply to that couple?": the answer is on the screen.

quotes.title: Send quotes you're proud of, in minutes
quotes.benefit: A polished quote that looks like it took you hours, ready in a few clicks.
points: Pick services from your catalog and the quote builds itself as you go
Your total and your margin update on their own, so you never undersell by mistake
Send a clean, on-brand quote while the client is still excited
See at a glance which quotes are sent, accepted, or about to expire
quotes.change: The quote that used to eat your whole evening now goes out before the client cools off.

orders.title: The trip prepares itself once it's sold
orders.benefit: An accepted quote turns into a ready-to-go checklist, on its own.
points: The moment a client says yes, the order and its to-do list appear automatically
Nothing to remember to book: every task is already waiting for you
Print a clean service sheet for the day of the trip
Always know where a file stands: awaiting payment, in progress, done
orders.change: No more "what did we still have to arrange for them?": the list already exists.

suppliers.title: Every guide and supplier, one search away
suppliers.benefit: Contacts, contracts and languages spoken, all in one place and up to date.
points: Find a guide's number or a hotel contract in seconds, instead of digging through old emails
Keep every document attached to the right supplier
See who speaks which language and covers which area before you book
See your whole history with each supplier, from past trips to the documents they sent
suppliers.change: When you need that guide right now, you actually find them.

catalog.title: Build quotes from prices you trust
catalog.benefit: Your services and rates ready to drop in, always current.
points: Reuse your services instead of retyping prices every single time
Set different rates by season, so you never quote last year's price by accident
Keep your cost and your selling price side by side, so your margin is never a guess
catalog.change: Quoting becomes picking from a list, not rebuilding everything from memory.

projects.title: Keep the big, complex trips under control
projects.benefit: Several alternative versions of a trip, neatly organized in one place.
points: Offer a client two or three versions of a trip without losing track
Keep the number of travelers and the trip's details tied to the project
Follow a complex file from first idea to departure in one place
projects.change: Group trips and "can you show me option B?" stop being a headache.

payments.title: Always know who still owes you
payments.benefit: One clear view of who has paid, who hasn't, and what you owe your suppliers.
points: See at a glance who paid the deposit and who still owes the balance before departure
Split a trip into payment milestones with due dates, and attach a payment link to each one
Track client and supplier invoices with clear statuses, in the same place
payments.change: The "have they paid?" spreadsheet disappears, and so does the forgotten reminder.

reports.title: See how the business is really doing
reports.benefit: A clear overview of your activity, without building a single spreadsheet.
points: One overview of quotes, orders and payments, always up to date
Numbers you can trust, because they come straight from your real files
reports.change: You step back and see the whole business at a glance, whenever you want.

multilang.title: Work in your language, sell in theirs
multilang.benefit: One tool for an international team and international clients.
points: Use the interface in French, English or Spanish
Handle each client's tax details the way their country expects

how_it_works.meta_description: From the client request to the invoice, discover the full journey of a file through Traviosoft, step by step.

intro.headline: From the client's first message to the final invoice
intro.text: Here's how a client file moves through Traviosoft, from the first request to invoicing. Each step builds on the information entered in the previous one: no double data entry, no files to copy elsewhere.

steps.title: One request, one place
steps.description: Add a new request yourself in seconds, or connect Traviosoft to your website so enquiries land in it on their own. Each one carries a clear status (new, awaiting reply, handled), so nothing slips between the inbox and a sticky note.
steps.before: Requests get lost between the inbox, paper notes and people's memory.
steps.after: Every request is visible in one place, with its status.
steps.name: Requests

steps.title: A quote built in minutes
steps.description: From the request, you put the quote together in minutes. The total and your margin are worked out for you, and you send it to the client with an expiry date in a couple of clicks.
steps.before: Every quote is rebuilt from scratch in Excel or Word, with the risk of calculation errors.
steps.after: The quote reuses your usual prices, works out the margin for you, and is ready to send in minutes.
steps.name: Quotes

steps.title: The client says yes, the work sets itself up
steps.description: As soon as the client accepts, the trip moves into preparation on its own: an order is created with a ready-made list of everything to arrange (bookings, documents to prepare, and so on). And when the client pays, the payment is recorded in the app automatically, so you always know where you stand.
steps.before: You have to re-read the accepted quote and manually recreate a task list in another tool.
steps.after: The order and its to-do list exist as soon as the quote is accepted, and payments show up on their own.
steps.name: Order setup

steps.title: Supplier coordination and service sheets
steps.description: The team follows the order's to-do list, prepares the service documents for the day of the trip, and coordinates suppliers and guides from their profiles (contacts, documents, languages spoken).
steps.before: Coordination happens through scattered emails and messages.
steps.after: Every task, supplier and document is linked to the corresponding order.
steps.name: Coordination

steps.title: Payments tracked, nothing forgotten
steps.description: Split the trip into payments (a deposit, then the balance, for example) and Traviosoft keeps an eye on each one: what's due, what's been paid, and what still needs a reminder, all in the same place.
steps.before: Payment tracking lives in a separate spreadsheet, with the risk of forgetting a reminder.
steps.after: Every milestone is linked to the quote and order, with its payment status.
steps.name: Payments

steps.title: Client and supplier invoices, with clear statuses
steps.description: Client invoices are generated with detailed line items and follow a precise status (draft, issued, partially paid, paid). Supplier invoices are tracked with the same level of detail, to keep a complete view of your real margins.
steps.before: Client and supplier invoices are tracked in separate documents, disconnected from the original quote.
steps.after: Everything stays linked to the client file, from the initial quote to the final invoice.
steps.name: Invoicing

faq.meta_description: Answers to frequently asked questions about Traviosoft: data security, setup time, data import, available languages and more.

intro.headline: Frequently asked questions
intro.text: If your question isn't here, ask it directly during the demo.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Your data sits on secure servers, and only the people you authorize at your agency can see it. It stays yours, and you can export it whenever you want.

items.question: How long does it take to get started?
items.answer: It depends on what you bring over: how many clients, open quotes and suppliers you have. On the demo we look at your real data together and give you a realistic idea of the time involved.

items.question: Is it suitable if I work alone? What about a team of 10 or 15?
items.answer: Both work. Traviosoft suits one person running everything from the first quote to the final invoice, and a team sharing the same trips, with users added as the team grows.

items.question: Can we import our existing clients, quotes or suppliers?
items.answer: Usually yes. If your data is in Excel or exported from another tool, we can bring it in. We settle the best way to do it on the demo, based on what you already have.

items.question: Is the software available in my language?
items.answer: The interface is available in French, English and Spanish, and each person on your team can pick their own.

items.question: What happens if I want to cancel?
items.answer: Your data stays yours. If you decide to leave, we arrange an export so you take it with you. The exact terms are set out in your service agreement, and we are happy to walk you through them.

items.question: Does Traviosoft replace my website or my accounting software?
items.answer: No. Traviosoft is the internal tool for running your quotes, orders, payments and suppliers. It doesn't replace your public website or your accounting software, though tracking your client and supplier invoices in it does make your accountant's job easier.

privacy.intro: This policy explains how we handle information collected through the traviosoft.com website. It covers the public website only. How we handle the data of the people who use the Traviosoft application is described in the [app privacy notice](/legal/app-privacy).

sections.heading: Who we are
body: This website is published by Sidoine Dantin EI, registered in France under SIRET 941 883 779 00014, 137 rue à Vaches, 62610 Balinghem, France, the business behind Traviosoft, management software for tailor-made travel agencies and DMCs. For any question about this policy or your data, you can contact us at privacy@traviosoft.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you ask for a demo, you choose a time in our booking window (Cal.com) or write to us by email. We receive what you enter in the form or in your email: your name, your email address, the name of your agency and any details you choose to add.

Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, records your IP address, your browser, the page requested and the time of the request in its server logs. If you accept advertising cookies, LinkedIn, Meta and Google also record your visit to this site (see "Advertising and audiences").

sections.heading: How we use your information
body: We use the details you give us to answer your demo request, prepare the call, and follow up about Traviosoft. We use technical logs to keep the site secure and working. We never sell your data. We share it only with the service providers needed to run the site and our email, and with LinkedIn, Meta and Google for our advertising as described below.

Where the law requires a legal basis, we rely on your request (to organize the demo you asked for), on your consent (for advertising cookies) and on our legitimate interest (to keep the site safe, to stay in contact with people who reached out to us, and to show our ads to travel businesses).

sections.heading: Third-party services
body: The website is delivered through Cloudflare's hosting and content network. Demo bookings are handled by Cal.com, Inc., which loads only when you open the booking window, receives what you enter there and adds the call to our calendar. Our ads run on LinkedIn (LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company), on Facebook and Instagram (Meta Platforms Ireland Limited), and on Google Search, YouTube, Gmail and partner websites (Google Ireland Limited). For the advertising cookies, LinkedIn and Meta act as joint controllers with us for their tags. Google acts as an independent controller. Their own privacy policies apply to what they do with the data. Cloudflare, Cal.com, LinkedIn, Meta and Google may transfer data to the United States under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Advertising and audiences
body: If you accept advertising cookies, the LinkedIn Insight Tag, the Meta Pixel and the Google tag record that your browser visited this site, which pages you saw and whether you opened the demo page, clicked to contact us or booked a demo. We use this to measure our ads and to show them again to people who visited the site. LinkedIn, Meta and Google give us only totals and audience sizes, never names.

We may also share a list of company names and websites with LinkedIn so that our ads reach those travel businesses. The list holds no names of people and no email addresses. We do this on the basis of our legitimate interest in presenting Traviosoft to travel professionals.

If you contact us or book a demo, we may also add your professional email address to our ad audience lists on LinkedIn and Meta, so that our ads keep reaching you while you look at Traviosoft. It is encrypted (hashed) before the upload, used only to match accounts and deleted by the platforms after matching. We do this on the basis of our legitimate interest in staying in contact with people who reached out to us, and you can object at any time as described below.

You can object at any time: write to privacy@traviosoft.com and we remove you from our lists, change your choice with "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page, or adjust your ad settings in your LinkedIn, Meta and Google accounts.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: The website uses the cookies it needs to work and to remember your language and your cookie choice. With your consent only, it also uses LinkedIn, Meta and Google advertising cookies. Under “Preferences” you can allow ad measurement alone (Google Ads counts the visits and demo bookings that come from our ads) or also ads on other sites (LinkedIn, Meta and Google). Refusing is as easy as accepting, and the site works the same either way. We ask again after six months.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: We keep the information from your demo request for as long as we are in contact about Traviosoft, and for three years after our last exchange. We do not receive the server logs: Cloudflare keeps them under its own policy.
Advertising cookies last at most 13 months. Contact details uploaded for advertising audiences are removed from our lists as soon as you object, and at the latest three years after our last exchange.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask to see the data we hold about you, to correct it, to have it deleted, to restrict its use or to receive it in a portable format. You can also object to its use, and withdraw your consent at any time. To make a request, email us at privacy@traviosoft.com: we answer within one month. You can also lodge a complaint with a data protection authority, in particular in the country where you live or work. As the business is based in France, its authority is the CNIL.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy as the website evolves. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

app_privacy.intro: This notice explains how we handle the personal data of the people who use the Traviosoft application: the staff of the agencies that subscribe to it. The data an agency records about its own clients, travellers and suppliers belongs to that agency, which decides how it is used. We process that data only on the agency's behalf, under our data processing agreement, so please contact the agency directly about it.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Traviosoft is published by Sidoine Dantin EI, SIRET 941 883 779 00014, 137 rue à Vaches, 62610 Balinghem, France, which is the controller of the data described in this notice. For any question or request, write to privacy@traviosoft.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Your account: your name, your professional email address, your role, the agency you belong to and your settings. Your password is stored only in encrypted form.
Security records: when you sign in and use the application, we record the date and time, your IP address and your browser, to protect your account and look into misuse.

How the application is used: if your agency leaves this on, we record which screens and functions are used. Every text and value on screen is masked, so we see clicks and pages, never your agency's data. When something fails, we also receive a technical error report.
Your messages: what you write to our support and the suggestions you send us.

The AI assistant: when you use it, your question, the conversation so far and the agency data the assistant reads to answer it are sent to the AI provider your agency chose. We keep a record of each action the assistant takes, with access keys, tokens and card numbers removed.

sections.heading: Why we use it
body: We use your account and send you sign-in emails and notifications to provide the service your agency subscribed to. This rests on our contract with your agency and on our legitimate interest in providing it.
We use security records to keep the application safe, which is our legitimate interest and our duty under data protection law.

We use usage records and error reports to fix problems and improve the application, on the basis of our legitimate interest. Your agency can turn usage records off, and you can object by writing to us.
We use your messages to answer you, on the basis of our legitimate interest. We use billing contacts to invoice your agency and keep our accounts, as the law requires.

sections.heading: Who receives it
body: Your agency's administrators see your account and your activity in their workspace. Our service providers process data for us, and each one is listed with its country on our [sub-processors page](/legal/subprocessors). We never sell your data and never use it for advertising.

sections.heading: Transfers outside the EU
body: Some of our providers are based in the United States. Those transfers rely on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses and, where the provider is certified, on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Your account stays as long as it exists in your agency's workspace. At the end of the agency's contract, it is deleted with the workspace once the data recovery period is over.

Security records are kept 13 months, usage records one year and error reports 90 days. Records of the AI assistant's actions are kept 90 days. Support messages are kept three years after our last exchange, and invoices ten years, as French accounting law requires.

sections.heading: Your rights

body: Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc., United States): sending the application's emails, such as sign-in links, notifications and documents sent to clients. Data is stored in the United States. Safeguards: standard contractual clauses and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.heading: AI assistant
body: Anthropic, PBC (United States) and OpenAI (United States): the answers of the AI assistant, from the provider the agency chooses. Neither uses the data to train its models. Safeguards: standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Translation and addresses
body: DeepL SE (Germany): translation of texts when a user asks for it.
komoot GmbH (Germany): address suggestions while a user types an address. It receives only the text typed.

sections.heading: Errors and usage
body: Functional Software, Inc., trading as Sentry (United States), with data stored in Germany: technical error reports.

PostHog, Inc. (United States), with data stored in the EU: records of how the application is used, with every text on screen masked. Each agency can turn this off. Safeguards for both: standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Services an agency connects itself
body: An agency can connect its own accounts, such as Google or Microsoft mailboxes, Xero, QuickBooks, MYOB, Fatture in Cloud, InvoiceXpress, Stripe, Redsys or Hotelbeds. These services work under the agency's own contract with them, and we send them only what the agency asks us to send.
